title: Kurzurlaub reviews
description: One row per guest rating (charged), plus a free hotel context row and a free status row per property.

type.description: Row type: review, hotel or status.

url.description: The Kurzurlaub hotel page, when the run was given one.

street.description: Hotel rows: street address (when the hotel page was read).

region.description: Hotel rows: Kurzurlaub's holiday region, e.g. Rhein / Lahn / Taunus.

country.description: Hotel rows: country, in German (Deutschland, Österreich, Italien…).

rating.description: Hotel rows: the property's overall score, 1-6 (6 is best).

rating_word.description: Hotel rows: Kurzurlaub's word for the overall score (Exzellent, Sehr gut, Gut…).

review_count.description: Hotel rows: how many ratings the property has.

category_averages.description: Hotel rows: the property's per-area averages — hotel, room, service, food, leisure, location, value — each 1-6.

price_range.description: Hotel rows: the price range of the hotel's current offers, as the page states it.

reviews_fetched.description: Hotel rows: how many ratings were taken for the property.

review_id.description: A stable id for the rating (Kurzurlaub gives ratings none; this is a hash of hotel, date, score, title, reviewer and comment — use it to dedupe scheduled runs).

score.description: The guest's overall score, 1-6 (6 is best).

category_scores.description: The per-area scores the guest gave — overall, hotel, room, service, food, leisure, location, value — only the areas rated appear.

title.description: The rating's title, as the guest wrote it (German).

text.description: The guest's comment, when there is one. Many Kurzurlaub ratings are a title and scores only.

reviewer.description: The guest's first name, or Gast when the guest stayed anonymous.

target.description: Status rows: the input this row is about.

status.description: Status rows: ok, no_reviews or error.

reviews.description: Status rows: rating rows delivered for the property.

filtered.description: Status rows: ratings dropped by maxScore / minScore / sinceDate (never charged).

total.description: Status rows: how many ratings Kurzurlaub shows for the property.

duplicates.description: Status rows: 1 when this input pointed at a property already harvested in the run.

error.description: Status rows: why the property failed, if it did.

fetched_at.description: When the row was fetched (UTC, ISO 8601).
